collectorNotes:
我直接读到了 OpenAI 发布页原文。普通 UA 访问返回 403，换成 Slackbot UA 后拿到了完整 HTML（1.4 MB），里面有评测表和带各推理档位的 vega 图表数据。表中 Terra 一列在 ALE、DeepSWE、OSWorld、AutomationBench、GDPval 五项上都等于图表里 max 档的数值，据此判定为 max effort。
结论汇总（primary 记录）：TB4 21.52（tbench 官方榜，Codex max）；DeepSWE v1.1 69.6（厂商数字，与 Datacurve 榜 0.6962 一致）；FrontierCode Main 41.31（Cognition 榜，max）；OSWorld 2.0 50.2（厂商数字，推断为 partial）；AutomationBench 15.2（厂商 7 月数字）；ALE Score 50.4（厂商数字，官方榜 max 为 50.70，Pass rate 27.96）；TB-Science 10.0（仅 Vals）；GDPval-AA v2 1593 Elo，换算为 54.65；gdp.pdf 24.7（推断为 all-pass）。
需要注意的地方：
(1) AutomationBench 厂商值 15.2 与 Zapier 当前 v1.0.6 私有集榜单的 23.59 差距较大，推测基准版本不同。合并时如需与其它模型统一按 v1.0.6 口径，应改用 23.59。
(2) Toolathlon 53.1 是原版而非 Verified：同表 GPT-5.5 55.6、Gemini 3.1 Pro 48.8 与 Verified 之前的旧榜完全一致。toolathlon-verified 因此列为 not_found。
(3) OSWorld 发布页没有写明 partial/binary 和全集/子集；partial 是根据 Snorkel 榜上 Sol 的 Partial 值 62.72 推断的。
(4) 发布页只报了 Terminal-Bench 2.1（87.4），按规则不记录。
(5) FrontierSWE 官方榜、Scale HLE 榜、OSWorld 2.0 官方站、tbench TB-Science 0.1 榜、Surge GDP.pdf 榜上都没有 Terra。System card 不含 HLE/SciCode/CritPt/AA-LCR。
(6) GPT-6 Astra 发布页虽然在图例中提到 Terra，但没有 Terra 的数据点。
没有使用 artificialanalysis.ai 自己的数字。
verifierSummary: I checked all 54 records. Each number appears at its URL for GPT-5.6 Terra itself, not a sibling model. 0 records corrected, not_found or unreachable. Method: curl to the original page. openai.com returns 403 to normal curl and to WebFetch, but returns the full page (1.4 MB) when requested with a Slackbot User-Agent. Its tables and chart data match the claims: ALE 50.4, GDPval-AA v2 1,593 Elo, DeepSWE v1.1 69.6, OSWorld 2.0 50.2, gdp.pdf 24.7, AutomationBench 15.2, Toolathlon 53.1. The chart data has a Terra point for each effort level from low to max (some charts also include none), and the values match one by one. All 5 GDPval Elo-to-score conversions are correct. Datacurve leaderboard-live.json (scope 113 tasks, generated_at 2026-09-22) matches on all 5 effort levels. Cognition data.json, key v1_1, matches on new_score. The page JS confirms new_score is the 'Score' the leaderboard shows; correct is the 'Pass rate'. The Zapier version 1.0.6 data sits in a Framer mjs script. The tbench.ai page source has rank 27, accuracy 21.52, n_trials 330. Page 9 of the Grok 4.7 Model Card has 'GPT-5.6 Terra (max) 21.5%' and the Harbor footnote. Vals TB4 shows 22.73% (updated 2026-10-07, mean of three pass@1 runs). Vals TB-Science shows 10.00% (updated 2026-10-08). ALE /api/demo/leaderboard: avgScore and passRate match exactly on the full split for all 5 effort levels. All comparability flags follow the column rules. Points not verified: (1) The OpenAI page does not say whether OSWorld 2.0 is a partial or binary score. WebSearch summaries of several aggregator sites (Yutori, BenchmarkList and others) list 50.2 as a partial score; I could not open Yutori directly. (2) The OpenAI page does not define the gdp.pdf metric, so all-pass is an inference. (3) The OpenAI page does not state an effort level for its table numbers. Most match the chart max points; Toolathlon and gdp.pdf have no chart to compare. (4) Single-run and effort details for Vals TB-Science are not shown on the page. Sources: https://openai.com/index/gpt-5-6/ , https://www.tbench.ai/leaderboard/terminal-bench/4.0 , https://media.x.ai/v1/website/4p7card-5eccc980.pdf , https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/terminal-bench-4 , https://www.vals.ai/benchmarks/terminal-bench-science , https://deepswe.datacurve.ai/artifacts/v1.1/leaderboard-live.json , https://cognition.com/data/frontiercode-leaderboard/data.json , https://zapier.com/benchmarks , https://agents-last-exam.org/api/demo/leaderboard , https://yutori.com/leaderboards/osworld-2 (found by search but the page did not load).
